lines.text: Many learners say: I am looking forward to see you.
Better: I am looking forward to seeing you.
Seeing! I look forward to seeing you.

en.tip: After look forward to, use -ing. Say “looking forward to seeing you”.
en.caption: Do you say “I am looking forward to see you”? 😅 Here “to” is a preposition, so the verb takes -ing. “I am looking forward to seeing you” is right. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
